description: Annotate a person for your organization: replace their tags, set notes, mute/unmute them, or set the outreach owner (ownerId, a member user id; null clears) and stage. Muting hides their posts from the feed and from every channel; ingest and billing are unchanged.

ownerId.description: The member who owns the contact (user id); null clears.

stage.description: Where your workspace stands with the person: not_contacted, contacted, replied, in_talks, customer or not_a_fit.
